interactions.sentence: [color=#ffffff][b]Hanh:[/b][/color] Has Binh been in? He looked exhausted when I saw him.

response_choices: He said your dates did not match.

interactions.sentence: [color=#ffffff][b]Hanh:[/b][/color] He has been worrying over a bit of paper. He ought to get some rest.
[color=#ffffff][b]Hanh:[/b][/color] I asked him to come over. We will sort out the book this evening.
[color=#ffffff][b]Hanh:[/b][/color] I need [b]two beers[/b], [b]three orange sodas[/b] and [b]two tins of canned meat[/b].
[color=#ffffff][b]Hanh:[/b][/color] Just neighbors coming round. It is easier to settle these things over a meal.
[color=#ffffff][b]Hanh:[/b][/color] Thank you. No need to mention our conversation to anyone.
